tweet.text:
Boring. Always the same story. Yes, yes, using libraries to access the internet. Okay, we know that.

Now cut off this backdoor we’ve known about for a year.

From now on, I’m not giving any more credit to AI environment escape tests that rely on libraries or package managers.

Fix that loophole and run the test again.

quote.text:
We’re sharing our alignment assessment of incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real systems during third-party cybersecurity evaluations mistakenly connected to the internet.

METR will also conduct an independent investigation, with wide-ranging access, including to transcripts beyond the window in which the incidents occurred, and to Anthropic employees permitted to share confidential information. Our initial agreement runs for eight weeks, and we intend to give METR as much time as it deems necessary to complete a thorough investigation. https://www.anthropic.com/research/alignment-assessment-cybersecurity-incidents
